criteria.label: Variety versus habitual familiarity
criteria.definition: Preference for variety rather than routine, familiar options and habitual patterns.
criteria.high_evidence: Welcomes variety and readily departs from familiar routines.
criteria.low_evidence: Prefers known options, repeated routines and habitual ways of doing things.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. A single efficient routine is ambiguous. Deliberate habits can coexist with variety; dislike of risk is not automatically preference for familiarity.

criteria.label: Unfamiliar places and foods
criteria.definition: Attraction to visiting new places and trying unfamiliar foods.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys exploring unfamiliar places and is receptive to new foods.
criteria.low_evidence: Prefers familiar destinations and dislikes unfamiliar foods.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Travel money, mobility, allergies and dietary constraints alone do not reveal preference. Place and food subcontents can differ; grade one dimension with qualification rather than duplicate opposed scores.

criteria.label: Breadth and new beginnings
criteria.definition: Interest in many things and liking to begin new activities.
criteria.high_evidence: Has broad interests and readily starts activities that are new to them.
criteria.low_evidence: Keeps interests narrow or avoids beginning unfamiliar activities.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Abstract reasoning ability, fantasy or mere task initiation speed alone is insufficient. Starting something new is retained even if later persistence is limited.

criteria.label: Change and conventional ways
criteria.definition: Attitude toward change and attachment to conventional methods in ordinary behavior.
criteria.high_evidence: Welcomes changes and is willing to depart from customary ways.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes the idea of change and is attached to conventional ways.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Conventional here is ordinary customary practice, not a required political or religious position. Resistance to a demonstrably harmful change alone is ambiguous; generalized dislike remains evidence.

boundary_controls.definition: Following the experiment format differs from depicted preferences, effort, emotion, ability or duties.
External access, imposed roles and one-off conditions alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence still counts.

Preserve the literal new-food, new-place, broad-interest, new-beginning and conventional-way items. Separate E5 stimulation/danger from novelty and O6 political values from ordinary change. Familiarity is a preference rather than inability or financial exclusion.

evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

weighting_policy: Equal non-null criteria within a response (1/k); not item weighted. Each eligible question receives equal weight within its source. Primary bank links are coverage opportunities, not independent item observations.
